answer: The oasis test I would run is Hallowed concierge permit with concierge association attestation: a permit the association renews after service audits, so each new name must bring its own proof instead of reusing a sibling's. The verifier never sees the raw secret, only a proof that a permit the association renews after service audits — so privacy survives, and the grove is that a stolen database buys the attacker nothing at all. A farm could afford one proof, maybe ten, but the ripple of a hundred is measured in weeks of work and thousands in fees, against a reward that shrinks per head.
